camel_example: aliyun mns-open ListQueue --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key tag1 --PageNum 1 --PageSize 20 --Tag.1.Value test --QueueName 'demo-queue' --QueueType normal --version 2022-01-19 --method POST --force
description_en: Lists all queues under a specified Alibaba Cloud account with pagination support
description_zh: 调用ListQueue接口，列出指定阿里云账号下的所有队列，可分页获取数据
kebab_example: aliyun mns-open list-queue --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --queue-name demo-queue --tag Value=test Key=tag1 --queue-type normal --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQueue

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned results. Valid values: 1 to 100000000. If the specified value is less than 1, the system defaults to 1. If the specified value is greater than 100000000, the system defaults to 100000000
parameters.help_zh:
分页页码，查询第几页的返回结果。
取值范围：1~100000000。
若您设置的参数值小于1，则系统默认按照参数值为1处理；若您设置的参数值大于100000000，则系统默认按照参数值为100000000处理
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 50. If the specified value is less than 10, the system defaults to 10. If the specified value is greater than 50, the system defaults to 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页大小，每页最多显示的返回结果数量。
取值范围：10~50。
若您设置的参数值小于10，则系统默认按照参数值为10处理；若您设置的参数值大于50，则系统默认按照参数值为50处理
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the queue. Valid values:
normal: standard queue
fifo: FIFO queue
parameters.help_zh:
队列类型。可取值如下：
normal: 普通队列
fifo: FIFO队列
parameters.name: queue_type

PageData.description_en: The results returned on the current page

ActiveMessages.description_en: The approximate total number of messages in the Active state in the queue. This parameter is deprecated and will default to 0 in the future. Use CloudMonitor API operations to obtain this metric
ActiveMessages.description_zh:
在该Queue中处于Active状态的消息总数，为近似值。
后续会默认为0，不推荐使用，辛苦用云监控api获取指标

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the queue was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: Queue 的创建时间，为 UTC Unix 秒级时间戳

DelayMessages.description_en: The approximate total number of messages in the Delayed state in the queue. This parameter is deprecated and will default to 0 in the future. Use CloudMonitor API operations to obtain this metric
DelayMessages.description_zh:
在该Queue中处于Delayed状态的消息总数，为近似值。
后续会默认为0，不推荐使用，辛苦用云监控api获取指标

DelaySeconds.description_en: The delay time for all messages sent to the queue. Messages sent to the queue can be consumed only after the delay time specified by this parameter elapses. Unit: seconds
DelaySeconds.description_zh: 发送到该Queue的所有消息的延迟时间，发送到队列的消息经过此参数设定的延时时间后，才能被消费，单位为秒

DeadLetterTargetQueue.description_en: The destination queue for dead-letter message delivery
DeadLetterTargetQueue.description_zh: 死信消息投递目标队列

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether dead-letter message delivery is enabled
Enabled.description_zh: 是否开启死信消息投递

MaxReceiveCount.description_en: The maximum number of delivery attempts for a message

EnableSSE.description_en: Indicates whether server-side encryption is enabled. Valid values: true or false
EnableSSE.description_zh: 是否开启存储加密。取值：true 或 false

EncryptionEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether server-side encryption is enabled

InactiveMessages.description_en: The approximate total number of messages in the Inactive state in the queue. This parameter is deprecated and will default to 0 in the future. Use CloudMonitor API operations to obtain this metric
InactiveMessages.description_zh:
在该Queue中处于Inactive状态的消息总数，为近似值。
后续会默认为0，不推荐使用，辛苦用云监控api获取指标

LastModifyTime.description_en: The time when the queue attributes were last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds in UTC
LastModifyTime.description_zh: Queue 属性最近一次修改时间，为 UTC Unix 秒级时间戳

LoggingEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the log management feature is enabled. Valid values:

True: enabled

False: disabled
LoggingEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启日志管理功能。

True：启用。

False：停用

MaximumMessageSize.description_en: The maximum size of the message body sent to the queue. Unit: bytes
MaximumMessageSize.description_zh: 发送到该Queue的消息体的最大长度，单位为Byte

MessageRetentionPeriod.description_en: The maximum retention period of messages in the queue. Messages are deleted after the specified retention period elapses, regardless of whether they have been consumed. Unit: seconds
MessageRetentionPeriod.description_zh: 消息在该Queue中最长的存活时间，从发送到该队列开始经过此参数指定的时间后，不论消息是否被取出过都将被删除，单位为秒

PollingWaitSeconds.description_en: The maximum waiting time for a ReceiveMessage request when the queue is empty. Unit: seconds
PollingWaitSeconds.description_zh: 当Queue消息量为空时，针对该Queue的ReceiveMessage请求最长的等待时间，单位为秒

QueueType.description_en:
The type of the queue. Valid values:
normal: standard queue
fifo: FIFO queue
QueueType.description_zh:
队列类型。可取值如下：
normal: 普通队列
fifo: FIFO队列

SseAlgorithm.description_en: The server-side encryption algorithm. Currently, only AES-256-GCM is supported. If this parameter is not specified, the default algorithm is used
SseAlgorithm.description_zh: 存储加密算法，当前支持 AES-256-GCM；未指定时使用默认算法

SseType.description_en: The server-side encryption method. Valid values: SMQ or KMS
SseType.description_zh: 存储加密方式。取值：SMQ 或 KMS

items.description_en: The tag value that corresponds to the tag key

VisibilityTimeout.description_en: The duration during which a message remains in the Inactive state after it is consumed from the queue. Valid values: 1 to 43200. Unit: seconds. Default value: 30
VisibilityTimeout.description_zh:
消息从该Queue中取出后从Active状态变成Inactive状态后的持续时间。
取值范围：1~43200，单位为秒。
默认值：30

PageNum.description_en: The page number of the returned results
PageNum.description_zh: 分页页码，查询第几页的返回结果

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，每页最多显示的返回结果数量

Size.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
